channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: FM Sitharaman 1st woman to present Budget for 9th consecutive time: PM Modi
item.description: Nirmala Sitharaman is the first woman to present the Union Budget for the ninth consecutive time, making history in the country's Parliamentary history, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said on Thursday.

item.title: Delhi High Court refuses to entertain Sameer Wankhede’s defamation plea against Netflix, SRK’s company
item.description: The Delhi High Court on Thursday refused to entertain the defamation suit filed by Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer Sameer Wankhede against Bollywood actor Shah Rukh Khan’s production house Red Chillies Entertainment Pvt Ltd and OTT platform Netflix over his alleged defamatory portrayal in the web series ‘The Ba**ds of Bollywood’*.

item.title: Who will take the reins of NCP? Leadership crisis looms after Ajit Pawar’s death
item.description: Following the untimely death of Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister and NCP chief Ajit Pawar, a debate has emerged regarding the party's future and who will lead it.

item.title: Karnataka Police arrest BBA student for secretly recording videos of women
item.description: The Karnataka Police on Thursday arrested a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) student on charges of recording romantic videos with different young women -- mostly daughters of local political leaders -- and making them viral on social media.

item.title: Voter enrollment deadline in TN ends on Jan 30; final electoral roll-on Feb 17
item.description: The extended deadline for inclusion of names in the electoral roll in Tamil Nadu will end on Friday (January 30), the Election Commission has reiterated, urging all eligible voters to complete the registration and correction process before the cutoff.

item.title: Delhi’s air quality remains poor; IMD issues yellow alert for fog
item.description: The Air Quality Index (AQI) in the national capital continued to remain in the ‘poor’ category on Thursday, with several monitoring stations recording levels above 300, indicating deteriorating air conditions in parts of the city.

item.title: Foreign ministers start arriving in Delhi for 2nd India-Arab meet
item.description: Foreign Ministers of several countries have started arriving in New Delhi to attend the second India–Arab Foreign Ministers' Meeting, slated for January 31.

item.title: As Gaza peace deal enters second phase, India commends US efforts to end conflict
item.description: As the Gaza peace deal enters the second phase, India has commended the US efforts to end the conflict.

item.title: Free trade for ambitious, confident youth and Aatmanirbhar Bharat: PM Modi on India-EU pact
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday said that the beginning of the India–European Union Free Trade Agreement reflects the spirit of an “ambitious, confident and Aatmanirbhar Bharat”.

item.title: FM Sitharaman tables Economic Survey 2026 in Parliament
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Thursday tabled the Economic Survey 2026 in Parliament, which will set the official tone on how the economy of the country is performing on a strong note despite global uncertainties and US tariffs.
